caption: The drawing depicts a single long-sleeved dress shown from the front with puffed sleeves and a full, floor-length skirt. The dress is colored in shades of light olive green with darker lines delineating seams and folds. The bodice features a v-shaped neckline created by overlapping fabric, gathered at the shoulders and cinched at the empire waist by a horizontal band. The sleeves are voluminous and gathered, tapering tightly at the wrist. The background is a plain beige color. To the right of the main dress illustration, there is a smaller, monochrome sketch of the same dress from the back, revealing the structure of the gathered fabric at the shoulders, the back view of the waist band, and the fullness of the skirt. Both the colored and outline drawings are on the same sheet, and no other objects appear in the composition.
title: Dress
